name: Incident Postmortem to Methodology
description: Turn a live incident into durable knowledge: capture the real finding, codify it as a methodology, pin it with a regression test.

steps.description: Record the real finding with live evidence: log lines, container ids, measured numbers. No folklore; anything not evidenced is labelled as unverified. Hands on the finding.
steps.name: capture_finding

steps.description: Draft the methodology with content-depth-gated rules (the flow of blueprint 10): concrete if-X-then-Y rules with real text. Hands on the methodology draft. Registration is done through the MethodologyCreate pipeline, which a blueprint step cannot name; the capability is recorded.
steps.name: codify_methodology

steps.description: Write the regression test that fails on the old behavior and passes on the fix. Hands on the test code. Running it needs a test-run capability that is not registered.
steps.name: pin_regression

missing_capabilities: methodology registration as a callable action (MethodologyCreate pipeline 12 cannot be named by a blueprint step)
